messages:
Ana (CS): Quick heads-up: a subset of recent signups are seeing their sample content not populate after activation. Emails went out but indexing jobs stalled. Not a full outage but a bad first-run experience for new users.

Mike S.: On it. How many tenants impacted?

Ana (CS): 9 confirmed so far, across trials and a couple self-serve startups.

Luis (Eng): Preliminary root cause: a recent change to ingest retry logic plus an unbounded partner template caused a backlog. Worker pool hit backpressure and retries piled up.

Ana (CS): We need a customer-facing status ASAP + targeted notes for CSMs handling trials. Also propose $50 trial credit and prioritized enablement sessions. Thoughts?

Julia P.: I'll draft two notes: short public status for all affected, and a private CSM technical note for enterprise trials.

Luis (Eng): Mitigation plan: restart indexing workers with conservative concurrency, kick a forced reindex endpoint with rate limits, and deploy a short-term patch to cap sample payload size. Ops can call:

POST /internal/v1/tenants/{tenant_id}/reindex
{ "mode": "rate_limited", "parallel": 10 }

deploy-bot: Reindex job scheduled for 9 tenants (job-5571).

Raj (CSM): One of my trial customers already messaged support, please tag their tenant for priority.

Ana (CS): Noted. Raj 99which tenant? (DM me)

Julia P.: GENERAL STATUS DRAFT:
Hi there 9we detected an issue between 14:209and 14:45 UTC where sample data indexing for some new accounts did not complete. Activation emails were delivered but sample content may be missing. We're sorry for the disruption.

What happened: an ingest retry/config interaction caused worker queue overload.
What we're doing: forcing a safe reindex for affected accounts, monitoring progress, and applying a temporary cap on sample payloads.
ETA: most accounts will see content restored within 209960 minutes.
No action required: we'll update you when reindex completes. If you need immediate assistance, reply and we'll prioritize.
As a courtesy we've applied a $50 one-time credit to affected trial accounts.
Thanks, Ana (Customer Success)

Julia P.: CSM NOTE DRAFT (private):
Hi <Name>,
We ran into partial ingestion for new signups in your trial window. We're reprocessing your tenant with controlled rate limits and will verify sample docs. We're offering a trial extension or $200 credit for paid trials; let us know your preference.
Technical appendix (for eng):

Root cause: retry storm + oversized sample template led to worker backpressure
Short-term mitigation: rate-limited forced reindex, restart workers, cap sample size to 1MB
Next steps: patch retry backoff and add queue-depth alerting

Ana (CS): Ops/Eng please confirm you can trigger reindexes and share ETA per tenant. Mike, can you run sanity checks and post periodic updates here? I'll coordinate outbound sends and credit application.

Mike S.: Starting reindex for 9 tenants now. I'll post statuses every 8 minutes.

Mike S.: 1/9 restored: tenant-2 OK (sample docs visible).

Mike S.: 4/9 in progress, error rate dropping.

Luis (Eng): Patch for retry backoff is queued; will land to prod after reindex stabilizes. Also adding an "estimated_restore_minutes" field to reindex response so CSMs can display ETA.

Raj (CSM): Flagged my high-risk trial tenant for priority; thanks.

Mike S.: 9/9 completed. Final smoke checks: expected sample doc counts restored, search returning results, no residual queue errors.

Ana (CS): Communications plan: publish GENERAL note to affected self-serve & trials, CSMs send private notes and offer enablement session + trial extension/credit as appropriate. Julia, publish the general note. Raj, follow up with your tenant and schedule a 30-min enablement slot.

Julia P.: General note sent (internal email link: https://redwood.internal/cs/outbound/3218880000/email).

Ana (CS): Apply credits per policy ($50 self-serve trial; $200 or 1-week extension for paid trials). Finance sign-off not required for these amounts.

Ana (CS): Also please collect a 2-question feedback pulse after enablement: 1) Did the session resolve onboarding issues? 2) Any remaining blockers? Add responses to the tracker.

Luis (Eng): I'll follow up with a timeline for the permanent fix and confirm deployment window (aiming today EOD).

Mike S.: Marking ops tasks complete. Monitoring for any regressions.

Ana (CS): Great work. I'll post a short customer-facing completion update in 30 minutes and close this thread after the follow-ups. :thumbsup:
